# A3.01 Text-only UX baseline (PROPOSED)

## Owner
A3

## Stage
Plan

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
CP-02

## Input (reads)
Approved stories and UX spec (no screenshot or Figma)

## Steps
1. Derive user journeys from the stories.
2. List screens and navigation between them.
3. Define screen states.
4. Label everything PROPOSED with a reason

## Output (writes)
PROPOSED UI/UX baseline

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/design/<ID>/ui-baseline.md`

## Verification
Every screen traces to a story; every item is labelled PROPOSED

## Checkpoints raised
- none
